name: Peapods Finance
rootCause: Peapods Finance suffered a price oracle manipulation attack on Ethereum Mainnet on July 8, 2025, resulting in the theft of approximately 78.5 ETH (~$207,000). The attacker exploited low-liquidity Uniswap V3 pools used as oracles for user-created Pods, inflating collateral price and borrowing against overvalued assets. Permissionless user-created Pods allowed choice of low-liquidity Uniswap V3 pools as TWAP oracles without validation. Attacker manipulated pool price, resulting in inflated collateral valuation and unbacked borrowing.
